lang.label: Language
login.title: Sign in to your files
forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your username and we will email a link to the address you confirmed on your account. The link works once and expires after 30 minutes.
forgot.noAddress: No confirmed address? Ask the owner to reset your password.
forgot.disabled: Reset by email is not set up on this server. Ask the owner to reset your password.
link.intro: Enter the email address you confirmed on your account and we will email a link. The link works once and expires after 15 minutes.
link.adminNote: Admins sign in with their password.
link.disabled: Sign-in links are not set up on this server. Sign in with your password.
signin.title: Sign in with your link
signin.intro: Press the button to sign in. Your password stays as it is.
reset.title: Choose a new password
confirm.title: Confirm your email address
confirm.intro: Confirm that this address may be used to reset your Filebox password.
password.title: Change your password
password.intro: This is also your SFTP password. You will be signed out everywhere afterwards.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
email.title: Email address
email.intro: If you forget your password, we email a reset link to this address. We email a link to confirm it first.
email.sent: Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.text: There is nothing at this address.
files.title: Your files
folder.heading: New folder in this folder
folder.name: Folder name
upload.heading: Upload to this folder
upload.drop: Or drop files and folders here
upload.checking: Checking for files that already exist...
upload.stoppedDisk: The remaining files were not uploaded.
upload.stoppedResume: Stopped because the connection was lost. Choose the same files again to continue where they stopped.
upload.stoppedNetwork: Stopped because the connection was lost.
upload.readFailed: Could not read what you selected.
upload.checkFailed: Could not check for existing files.
upload.startFailed: The upload could not be started.
upload.incomplete: The upload could not be completed.
backup.title: Back up photos
backup.intro: Choose the photos and videos on this phone that you want to keep safe. They are saved in the folder Photo backup, sorted by year and month.
backup.keepOpen: Keep this page open while it uploads. Your phone can pause the upload when the screen locks or when you switch to another app, and it continues by itself when you come back.
backup.awake: The screen stays on while uploading.
backup.awakeUnsupported: This browser cannot keep the screen on. Keep this page open and do not let the screen lock while it uploads.
backup.waiting: The connection was lost. The upload continues by itself as soon as the connection is back.
backup.skipped.one: {count} was already backed up and skipped.
backup.skipped.other: {count} were already backed up and skipped.
backup.renamed.one: {count} was saved under a new name because a different photo already had that name.
backup.renamed.other: {count} were saved under a new name because different photos already had those names.
backup.badName: This file name cannot be used.
backup.tooManyNames: There are too many files with this name in the same month.
conflict.intro: Some files already exist. Choose what to do with each.
conflict.folderExists: A folder with this name exists.
trash.title: Your trash
trash.confirmEmpty: This deletes everything in the trash for good.
trash.summary.one: {count} item in the trash, {size} in total. Items are removed for good after 30 days.
trash.summary.other: {count} items in the trash, {size} in total. Items are removed for good after 30 days.
family.title: Family folder
family.intro: Everyone with an account can see, add, rename and delete files here. They do not count towards anyone's storage quota, and they are only available on the website, not over SFTP.
family.trashIntro: Deleted family files stay here for 30 days. Anyone can restore them.
photos.title: Your photos
photos.empty: No photos or videos here yet.
photos.nothingToJump: There is nothing to jump to yet.
photos.nothingOldest: Nothing from {label} or earlier, showing the oldest.
photos.nothingClosest: Nothing from {label}, showing the closest earlier month.
viewer.label: File preview
viewer.failed: This file could not be previewed. Download it instead.
viewer.tooLarge: Too large to preview, download instead.
storage.label: Storage
storage.full: The disk is full. New uploads are paused until space is freed. You can still download and delete files.
storage.quotaPercent: You have used {percent}% of your storage.
storage.familyTrashHolds: The family trash holds {size}, which still counts as used.
storage.trashHolds: Your trash holds {size}, which still counts as used.
storage.emptyBelow: Empty it below to free space.
tv.help: Add this link as an M3U playlist in an IPTV app such as VLC, Kodi or TiviMate. The program guide is included automatically.
tv.warning: Anyone with this link can watch, so do not share it outside the family.
tv.disabled: TV is not set up on this server.
tv.copyByHand: Copy it by hand: the text is selected.
admin.quotaNotice: Limits how much {name} can store. Lowering it below current use deletes nothing; it only blocks new files.
admin.quotaRange: Enter a limit between 1 MiB and 1 PiB.
admin.clearNotice: {name} will be able to store as much as the disk has room for.
admin.demoteNotice: {name} will no longer be able to manage accounts.
admin.promoteNotice: {name} will be able to create and delete accounts and reset passwords.
admin.deleteNotice: This deletes the account {name}. It cannot be undone.
files.shareNotice: Anyone with the link can download {name}, without signing in.
shares.title: Shared links
shares.intro: Anyone with a link can download what it points to, without signing in. A link only works while the file or folder stays where it is. To make a new link, use Share in your files.
shares.empty: You have not shared anything yet.
shares.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Copy the link yourself: {url}
shares.revokeNotice: The link {name} stops working right away.
share.title: Shared with you
share.footer: You are viewing a link someone shared with you. You can only download from it.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.password_check_failed: Could not check the password right now.
error.account_changed: Your account just changed. Try again.
error.family_unavailable: Could not open the family folder.
error.password_invalid: The password must be 12 to 128 characters on a single line.
error.username_invalid: The username must be 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter.
error.user_exists: A user with that name already exists.
error.role_invalid: The role must be user or admin.
error.own_admin_role: You cannot remove your own admin role.
error.own_account: You cannot delete your own account.
error.last_admin: There must always be at least one admin.
error.admin_protected: Admins cannot reset another admin's password.
error.quota_admin_target: Admins cannot set a storage limit on an admin.
error.quota_invalid: The limit must be between 1 MB and 1 PB.
error.quotas_unavailable: Storage limits are not enabled for this user. The server needs btrfs quotas and the user's folder converted to a subvolume.
error.quota_change_failed: Could not change the storage limit.
error.email_unavailable: Email is not set up on this server. Ask the owner.
error.email_invalid: Enter one plain email address such as name@example.com.
error.email_send_failed: Could not send the email right now. Try again later.
error.link_invalid: This link is not valid or has expired.
error.path_invalid: That name or path is not valid.
error.folder_not_empty: The folder is not empty. Delete what is inside first.
error.already_exists: Something with that name already exists.
error.folder_exists: A folder with that name already exists.
error.not_a_folder: Part of that path is not a folder.
error.no_thumbnail: This file type has no thumbnail.
error.quota_exceeded: You are over your storage quota. Empty the trash, delete files, or ask an admin for more space.
error.into_self: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
error.upload_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
error.upload_invalid: The upload request was not valid. Try uploading the file again.
error.upload_out_of_sync: The upload got out of step with the server. Try uploading the file again.
error.disk_full: The disk is full, so new uploads are paused. Delete files or empty the trash to free space.
error.preview_unsupported: This file type cannot be previewed.
error.thumbs_unavailable: Thumbnails are not available on this server.
error.thumb_failed: This file could not be turned into a picture.
error.date_invalid: The date must be a day like 2024-05-17, from 1900 up to tomorrow.
error.date_not_media: Only photos and videos have a date.
error.too_many_dates: Too many photos have a custom date. Reset some first.
error.share_name_invalid: A name has 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
error.share_name_reserved: That name is used by the site itself. Choose another.
error.share_target_invalid: Choose a file or folder in your own files.
error.share_limit: You have reached the limit of 100 share links. Revoke one first.
error.share_expiry_invalid: Choose how long the link works.
answer.reset_link_sent: If that account exists and has a confirmed address, we sent an email.
answer.sign_in_link_sent: If that address belongs to an account, we sent a link.
